mainEntity.name: What types of addiction treatment programs does Rose City Recovery offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rose City Recovery offers a full continuum of care to support individuals at different stages of recovery. Programs include medically supported detox, residential inpatient treatment, and outpatient services. Each program is designed to address both substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions, ensuring clients receive well-rounded, effective care based on their specific needs.

mainEntity.name: How is treatment personalized for each client?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment at Rose City Recovery is never one-size-fits-all. Every client receives an individualized treatment plan developed after a comprehensive assessment. This plan considers substance use history, mental health concerns, personal goals, and life circumstances. Therapies and services are adjusted as clients progress, allowing care to evolve alongside their recovery journey.

mainEntity.name: What therapies and treatment approaches are used?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rose City Recovery focuses on evidence-based therapies combined with holistic approaches. Treatment may include individual counseling, group therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, relapse prevention planning, and trauma-informed care. Holistic elements are also incorporated to support emotional balance, stress management, and overall well-being, helping clients build a strong foundation for lasting recovery.

mainEntity.name: Is mental health treatment available alongside addiction care?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, mental health support is a core part of treatment at Rose City Recovery. Many individuals struggle with co-occurring mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, or trauma. The clinical team is experienced in treating both substance use disorders and mental health challenges together, which is essential for long-term recovery and stability.

mainEntity.name: What makes Rose City Recovery different from other treatment centers in Ontario?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rose City Recovery stands out for its personalized approach, experienced clinical team, and commitment to creating a safe, supportive environment. Located in Welland, Ontario, the center combines professional medical care with compassion and respect, focusing not only on sobriety but on helping clients rebuild confidence, life skills, and a meaningful future beyond treatment.

about_blocks.text: Rose City Recovery is a trusted addiction treatment center located in Welland, Ontario, committed to helping individuals overcome substance use disorders and mental health challenges through compassionate, evidence-based care. Our mission is simple but powerful, to support long-term recovery by treating the whole person, not just the addiction.

about_blocks.text: At Rose City Recovery, we offer a full continuum of care designed to meet clients exactly where they are in their recovery journey.
